##2 QC
```{r}

#check the threshold before
colData(sce)
hist(
  colSums(counts(sce) > 0),
  breaks = 100,
  main = "Detected genes per cell",
  xlab = "Number of genes"
)

# basic filters
sce <- scater::addPerCellQC(sce)
min.features <- 500
min.cells <- 5

qc <- scater::perCellQCMetrics(sce)
sce <- sce[rowSums(counts(sce) >= 1) >= min.cells, ]
 sce <-  sce[, colSums(counts(sce) >= 1) >= min.features]


#mt
is.mito <- grep("MT-", rownames(sce))
per.cell <- scuttle::perCellQCMetrics(sce, subsets=list(Mito=is.mito))
colData(sce)[['subsets_Mito_percent']] <- per.cell$subsets_Mito_percent

class(colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent)
hist(
  colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent,
  breaks = 100,
  main = "Mitochondrial percentage per cell",
  xlab = "Percent mitochondrial reads"
)
sce <- sce[, colData(sce)$subsets_Mito_percent < 15]


```

##4 cell cell comm
```{r}

liana_res <- liana_bysample(
  sce = sce,
  sample_col = "Condition",
  idents_col = "General",
  resource = 'Consensus',
  expr_prop = 0.1,
  min_cells = 5,
  assay.type = 'logcounts',
  aggregate_how = 'both',
  verbose = TRUE,
  inplace = FALSE,
  permutation.params = list(nperms = 100),
  return_all = TRUE
)

# convert to dataframe
names(liana_res) <- unique(colData(sce)$Condition)
liana_res <- bind_rows(liana_res, .id = "Condition")
liana_res$Condition <- as.character(liana_res$Condition)

table(liana_res$Condition)
write.csv(liana_res, file = "CCC/Fusion/output/liana_res.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# filter
liana_filt <- liana_res %>%
  filter(magnitude_rank <= 0.05,
         cellphonedb.pvalue <= 0.01)
table(liana_filt$Condition)
write.csv(liana_filt, file = "CCC/Fusion/output/liana_filt.csv", row.names = FALSE)

liana_filt=read.csv("CCC/Fusion/output/liana_filt.csv")


```


```{r}

library(dplyr)

#1. exclude the same cell types used throughout the project

                         "Keratinocytes", "Endocrine Cells", "Smooth Muscle Cells",
```

#5.#We can use Tensor-cell2cell to infer context-dependent
#CCC patterns from multiple samples simultaneously. 

```{r}

# store by condition using filtered cell types
sce@metadata[['liana_filt']] <- split(liana_filt_twice, liana_filt_twice$Condition)

# update sorted samples
sorted_samples <- sort(names(sce@metadata[['liana_filt']]))

# build tensor
context_df_dict <- liana:::preprocess_scores(
  context_df_dict = sce@metadata[['liana_filt']],
  invert = TRUE,
  invert_fun = function(x) 1 - x,
  non_negative = TRUE,
  non_negative_fill = 0
)

tensor <- liana_tensor_c2c(
  context_df_dict = context_df_dict,
  sender_col = "source",
  receiver_col = "target",
  ligand_col = "ligand.complex",
  receptor_col = "receptor.complex",
  score_col = 'magnitude_rank',
  how = 'outer_cells',
  outer_fraction = 1/3,
  context_order = sorted_samples,
  conda_env = '/mnt/nfs/home/aminata.sow/miniforge3/envs/lianaenv',
  build_only = TRUE,
  device = use_gpu
)

#save tensor
tensor$shape
reticulate::py_save_object(tensor, "CCC/Fusion/output/tensor_bycondition_filt.pkl")

library(reticulate)
tensor <- py_load_object("CCC/Fusion/output/tensor_bycondition_filt.pkl")



```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)

#1. store factors

sce@metadata$tensor_res <- liana:::format_c2c_factors(tensor$factors)
sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts$Condition <- as.character(sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts$context)

condition_col <- "Condition"
sample_col <- "Condition"

condition_colors <- c(
  "IPF.L"    = "#E63946",
  "IPF.U"    = "#F4A261",
  "MS"       = "#2A9D8F",
  "RA"       = "#457B9D",
  "SjD"      = "#8338EC",
  "SS"       = "#FB5607",
  "SScILD.L" = "#FFBE0B",
  "SScILD.U" = "#3A86FF",
  "T1D"      = "#06D6A0",
  "LN"       = "#6D6875"
)


#1b. exclude the same cell types filtered throughout the project, and
# use the SAME consistent color palette (instead of the previous
# celltype_colors, which had different colors/categories)

excluded_celltypes <- c("Glial Cells", "Neurons", "Immune Cells", "Melanocytes",
                         "Keratinocytes", "Endocrine Cells", "Smooth Muscle Cells",
                         "Plasma Cells")

celltype_colors <- c(
  "B Cells"             = "gold",
  "CD4"                 = "olivedrab2",
  "CD8"                 = "tomato",
  "NK Cells"            = "magenta",
  "Mono/Mac"            = "darkblue",
  "Mast Cells"          = "#FDBF6F",
  "Proliferating Cells" = "#B15928",
  "Endothelial Cells"   = "#E31A1C",
  "Fibroblasts"         = "cyan",
  "Mural Cells"         = "#1F78B4",
  "Epithelial Cells"    = "mediumpurple2"
)

# filter senders/receivers tables to drop the excluded cell types BEFORE
# any plotting happens
sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders %>%
  filter(!celltype %in% excluded_celltypes)

sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers %>%
  filter(!celltype %in% excluded_celltypes)

cat("Cell types kept in senders:\n")
print(sort(unique(sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders$celltype)))
cat("Cell types kept in receivers:\n")
print(sort(unique(sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers$celltype)))

missing_colors <- setdiff(
  unique(c(sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders$celltype,
           sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers$celltype)),
  names(celltype_colors)
)
if (length(missing_colors) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING - these cell types have no assigned color:\n")
  print(missing_colors)
}


#2. overview plot (contexts, interactions, senders, receivers per factor)

factors <- paste0("Factor.", 1:12)

plots <- lapply(factors, function(f) {
  p_ctx <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = context, y = .data[[f]], fill = context)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = "", y = f, title = if(f == "Factor.1") "Contexts" else "")

  p_int <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$interactions %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = lr, y = .data[[f]])) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey40") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = if(f == "Factor.1") "Interactions" else "")

  p_snd <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = celltype, y = .data[[f]], fill = celltype)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = if(f == "Factor.1") "Senders" else "")

  p_rcv <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = celltype, y = .data[[f]], fill = celltype)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = if(f == "Factor.1") "Receivers" else "")

  p_ctx | p_int | p_snd | p_rcv
})

leg_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::get_legend(
    ggplot(sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts, aes(x = context, y = Factor.1, fill = context)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) + labs(fill = "Condition")
  ),
  cowplot::get_legend(
    ggplot(sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders, aes(x = celltype, y = Factor.1, fill = celltype)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) + labs(fill = "Cell type")
  ),
  ncol = 2
)

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1) | leg_combined
ggsave("CCC/Fusion/output/tensor_overview_12factors.pdf", final_plot, width = 22, height = 40)


#3. downstream visualization

sample_loadings <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts %>%
  pivot_longer(-c('Condition', 'context'), names_to = "factor", values_to = "loadings") %>%

ggbarplot(sample_loadings, x = condition_col, y = "loadings", fill = condition_col) +

ggsave("CCC/Fusion/output/tensor_downstream_visualization.pdf", width = 20, height = 15)
```

###6.shared and unique interactions between factors
```{r}

# test multiple thresholds
thresholds <- c(0.046, 0.059, 0.07)  # median, 3rd quartile, stringent custom

threshold_results <- lapply(thresholds, function(threshold) {
  lr_assign <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$interactions %>%
    pivot_longer(-lr, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
    filter(loading > threshold) %>%
    group_by(lr) %>%
    summarise(n_factors = n_distinct(factor), .groups = "drop")
  
  data.frame(
    threshold = threshold,
    unique = sum(lr_assign$n_factors == 1),
    shared = sum(lr_assign$n_factors > 1),
    total = nrow(lr_assign)
  )
})

threshold_summary <- do.call(rbind, threshold_results)
print(threshold_summary)

# use the chosen threshold

threshold <- 0.059

lr_factor_assignment <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$interactions %>%
  pivot_longer(-lr, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  filter(loading > threshold) %>%
  group_by(lr) %>%
  summarise(n_factors = n_distinct(factor),
            factors = paste(unique(factor), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop")

unique_int <- lr_factor_assignment %>% filter(n_factors == 1)
shared_int <- lr_factor_assignment %>% filter(n_factors > 1)

cat("Threshold:", threshold, "\n")
cat("Unique interactions:", nrow(unique_int), "\n")
cat("Shared interactions:", nrow(shared_int), "\n")

# save
write.csv(threshold_summary, "CCC/Fusion/output/threshold_test.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(unique_int, "CCC/Fusion/output/unique_interactions_per_factor.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(shared_int, "CCC/Fusion/output/shared_interactions_between_factors.csv", row.names = FALSE)

shared_int=read.csv("CCC/Fusion/output/shared_interactions_between_factors.csv")




```




```{r}

##plots shared

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

factor_levels <- paste0("Factor.", 1:12)

# top 40 shared LR pairs
top40_shared <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$interactions %>%
  pivot_longer(-lr, names_to = "factor", values_to = "int_loading") %>%
  filter(lr %in% shared_int$lr) %>%
  group_by(lr) %>%
  summarise(max_loading = max(int_loading), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(max_loading, n = 40) %>%
  pull(lr)

# lr factors pairs
shared_expanded <- shared_int %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(factors, sep = ", ")
shared_expanded <- data.frame(
  lr = shared_expanded$lr,
  factor = trimws(shared_expanded$factors)
)
lr_factor <- shared_expanded %>%
  filter(lr %in% top40_shared)

#barplot for condition in each factor
ctx_long <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(context, Condition), names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = factor_levels))

p_bar <- ggplot(ctx_long, aes(x = factor, y = loading, fill = context)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right") +
  labs(x = "Factor", y = "Context loading", fill = "Condition")

# top senders and receivers / factor
top_sender <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "sender_loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(sender_loading, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

top_receiver <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "receiver_loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(receiver_loading, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# ONE shared size scale, same name in both plots, so it merges into a
# single "Loading" legend instead of two separate ones
shared_size_scale <- scale_size(name = "Loading", range = c(1, 6))

# senders dotplot - this is the ONLY plot that shows the Cell type and
# Loading legends. LR pair labels (y-axis) explicitly set to black.

sender_dot <- lr_factor %>%
  left_join(top_sender, by = "factor") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = factor_levels))

p_snd <- ggplot(sender_dot, aes(x = factor, y = lr,
                                 size = sender_loading,
                                 color = celltype)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_colors, limits = names(celltype_colors), drop = FALSE) +
  shared_size_scale +
  guides(size = guide_legend(order = 1),
         color = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Factor", y = "Ligand-Receptor pair",
       color = "Cell type",
       title = "Senders")

# receivers dotplot - color AND size legends both suppressed, since
# Senders already shows the identical Cell type + Loading legends. Same
# explicit black LR pair label color as Senders.

receiver_dot <- lr_factor %>%
  left_join(top_receiver, by = "factor") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = factor_levels))

p_rcv <- ggplot(receiver_dot, aes(x = factor, y = lr,
                                   size = receiver_loading,
                                   color = celltype)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_colors, limits = names(celltype_colors),
                      drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  shared_size_scale +
  guides(size = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Factor", y = "Ligand-Receptor pair",
       color = "Cell type",
       title = "Receivers")

# combine plots - guides="collect" merges/deduplicates legends across
# all three subplots (p_bar, p_snd, p_rcv) into one consistent legend
# column, positioned on the right

final_plot <- (p_bar / (p_snd | p_rcv)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 6), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

dir.create("CCC/Fusion/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave("CCC/Fusion/output/detailed_dotplot_factor_shared_interactions.pdf",
       final_plot, width = 24, height = 20)



  





```

##plots top 5% of ecah factor
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

top_pct <- 0.05   # top 5% of interactions, computed SEPARATELY for each factor
# (a fixed % per factor, not a global percentage across all LR pairs -
# each factor's own loading distribution determines its own 95th percentile)

factors_all <- paste0("Factor.", 1:12)


#1. dominant sender/receiver cell type per factor

top_sender_per_factor <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = loading, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(factor, top_sender = celltype)

top_receiver_per_factor <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = loading, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(factor, top_receiver = celltype)


#2. get the TOP 5% interactions PER FACTOR (separately for each factor's
# own loading distribution)

interactions_long <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$interactions %>%
  pivot_longer(-lr, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading")

top_interactions <- interactions_long %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  filter(loading >= quantile(loading, 1 - top_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(top_sender_per_factor, by = "factor") %>%
  left_join(top_receiver_per_factor, by = "factor") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = factors_all)) %>%
  arrange(factor, desc(loading))

cat("Total dots in the plot (top", top_pct * 100, "% per factor):", nrow(top_interactions), "\n")

# how many LR pairs appear in MORE than one factor's top 5% (i.e. shared)
lr_factor_counts <- top_interactions %>%
  group_by(lr) %>%
  summarise(n_factors = n_distinct(factor), .groups = "drop")

cat("LR pairs unique to one factor:", sum(lr_factor_counts$n_factors == 1), "\n")
cat("LR pairs shared across >=2 factors:", sum(lr_factor_counts$n_factors > 1), "\n")


#3. save as CSV

dir.create("CCC/Fusion/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(top_interactions, "CCC/Fusion/output/top5pct_lr_per_factor.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)



top_pct <- 0.05   # top 5% of interactions, computed SEPARATELY for each factor
# (a fixed % per factor, not a global percentage across all LR pairs -
# each factor's own loading distribution determines its own 95th percentile)

factors_all <- paste0("Factor.", 1:12)


#1. dominant sender/receiver cell type per factor (same as before)

top_sender_per_factor <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = loading, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(factor, top_sender = celltype)

top_receiver_per_factor <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = loading, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(factor, top_receiver = celltype)


#2. get the TOP 5% interactions PER FACTOR (separately for each factor's
# own loading distribution) - if the same lr pair appears in more than
# one factor's top 5%, that lr pair is genuinely SHARED across those
# factors (independently ranked strong in each one), not a coincidence

interactions_long <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$interactions %>%
  pivot_longer(-lr, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading")

top_interactions <- interactions_long %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  filter(loading >= quantile(loading, 1 - top_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(top_sender_per_factor, by = "factor") %>%
  left_join(top_receiver_per_factor, by = "factor") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = factors_all)) %>%
  arrange(factor, desc(loading))

cat("Total dots in the plot (top", top_pct * 100, "% per factor):", nrow(top_interactions), "\n")

# how many LR pairs appear in MORE than one factor's top 5% (i.e. shared)
lr_factor_counts <- top_interactions %>%
  group_by(lr) %>%
  summarise(n_factors = n_distinct(factor), .groups = "drop")

cat("LR pairs unique to one factor:", sum(lr_factor_counts$n_factors == 1), "\n")
cat("LR pairs shared across >=2 factors:", sum(lr_factor_counts$n_factors > 1), "\n")


#2b. find which PAIR of factors shares the most LR pairs (from the top
# 5% selection), so we can highlight both with the same color

lr_sets <- split(top_interactions$lr, top_interactions$factor)
lr_sets <- lr_sets[sapply(lr_sets, length) > 0]   # drop empty factors, if any

factor_pairs <- combn(names(lr_sets), 2, simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_shared <- sapply(factor_pairs, function(pair) {
  length(intersect(lr_sets[[pair[1]]], lr_sets[[pair[2]]]))
})

best_pair_idx <- which.max(pairwise_shared)
highlight_factors <- factor_pairs[[best_pair_idx]]
n_shared_best <- pairwise_shared[best_pair_idx]

cat("\nFactor pair sharing the MOST LR pairs:",
    paste(highlight_factors, collapse = " & "),
    "-", n_shared_best, "shared LR pairs\n")


#3. save as CSV

dir.create("CCC/Fusion/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(top_interactions, "CCC/Fusion/output/top5pct_lr_per_factor.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: CCC/Fusion/output/top5pct_lr_per_factor.csv\n")


#4. colors (same as before)

celltype_cols <- c(
  "B Cells"             = "gold",
  "CD4"                 = "olivedrab2",
  "CD8"                 = "tomato",
  "NK Cells"            = "magenta",
  "Mono/Mac"            = "darkblue",
  "Mast Cells"          = "#FDBF6F",
  "Proliferating Cells" = "#B15928",
  "Endothelial Cells"   = "#E31A1C",
  "Fibroblasts"         = "cyan",
  "Mural Cells"         = "#1F78B4",
  "Epithelial Cells"    = "darksalmon"
)

condition_colors <- c(
  "IPF.L"    = "#E63946",
  "IPF.U"    = "#F4A261",
  "MS"       = "#2A9D8F",
  "RA"       = "#457B9D",
  "SjD"      = "#8338EC",
  "SS"       = "#FB5607",
  "SScILD.L" = "#FFBE0B",
  "SScILD.U" = "#3A86FF",
  "T1D"      = "#06D6A0",
  "LN"       = "#6D6875"
)


#4b. build highlight: 

highlight_positions <- match(highlight_factors, factors_all)
highlight_color <- "#B2182B"

highlight_rects <- lapply(highlight_positions, function(pos) {
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = pos - 0.5, xmax = pos + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = highlight_color, alpha = 0.15)
})

# colored/bold labels only for the two highlighted factors, plain for the rest
axis_label_colors <- ifelse(
  factors_all %in% highlight_factors,
  paste0("<b style='color:", highlight_color, "'>", factors_all, "</b>"),
  factors_all
)
names(axis_label_colors) <- factors_all


#5. disease contribution barplot on top

context_long <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(context, Condition), names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  mutate(factor = factor(factor, levels = factors_all)) %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  mutate(proportion = loading / sum(loading)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_bar <- ggplot(context_long, aes(x = factor, y = proportion, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(y = "Disease\ncontribution", fill = "Condition")


#6. Senders dotplot

p_snd <- ggplot(top_interactions, aes(x = factor, y = lr,
                                       size = loading, color = top_sender)) +
  highlight_rects +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_label_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Factor", y = "Ligand-Receptor pair",
       size = "Interaction\nscore", color = "Sender cell type",
       title = "Senders")


#7. Receivers dotplot

p_rcv <- ggplot(top_interactions, aes(x = factor, y = lr,
                                       size = loading, color = top_receiver)) +
  highlight_rects +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 6)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_label_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Factor", y = NULL,
       size = "Interaction\nscore", color = "Receiver cell type",
       title = "Receivers")


#8. combine


final_plot <- p_bar / (p_snd | p_rcv) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 5))

n_lr <- length(unique(top_interactions$lr))

ggsave("CCC/Fusion/output/Top_5per_factor_highlight.pdf",
       final_plot, width = 20, height = max(10, n_lr * 0.28), limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

#1. build disease x factor loading matrix from the contexts table

factor_levels <- paste0("Factor.", 1:12)

ctx_wide <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$contexts %>%
  select(Condition, all_of(factor_levels)) %>%
  distinct(Condition, .keep_all = TRUE)

disease_factor_mat <- as.matrix(ctx_wide[, factor_levels])
rownames(disease_factor_mat) <- ctx_wide$Condition

cat("Disease x Factor matrix dimensions:", dim(disease_factor_mat), "\n")
print(round(disease_factor_mat, 3))


#2. dominant sender / receiver cell type per factor 

top_sender_per_factor <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$senders %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = loading, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(factor, top_sender = celltype)

top_receiver_per_factor <- sce@metadata$tensor_res$receivers %>%
  pivot_longer(-celltype, names_to = "factor", values_to = "loading") %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = loading, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(factor, top_receiver = celltype)

factor_annotation <- data.frame(factor = factor_levels) %>%
  left_join(top_sender_per_factor, by = "factor") %>%
  left_join(top_receiver_per_factor, by = "factor")

rownames(factor_annotation) <- factor_annotation$factor
factor_annotation <- factor_annotation[colnames(disease_factor_mat), ]

cat("Top sender/receiver per factor:\n")
print(factor_annotation)


#3. colors

celltype_cols <- c(
  "B Cells"             = "gold",
  "CD4"                 = "olivedrab2",
  "CD8"                 = "tomato",
  "NK Cells"            = "magenta",
  "Mono/Mac"            = "darkblue",
  "Mast Cells"          = "#FDBF6F",
  "Proliferating Cells" = "#B15928",
  "Endothelial Cells"   = "#E31A1C",
  "Fibroblasts"         = "cyan",
  "Mural Cells"         = "#1F78B4",
  "Epithelial Cells"    = "mediumpurple2"
)


#4. column annotation: dominant sender / receiver cell type per factor -


col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Top sender`   = factor_annotation$top_sender,
  `Top receiver` = factor_annotation$top_receiver,
  col = list(
    `Top sender`   = celltype_cols,
    `Top receiver` = celltype_cols
  ),
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  simple_anno_size = unit(4, "mm")
)

present_celltypes <- intersect(
  names(celltype_cols),
  unique(c(factor_annotation$top_sender, factor_annotation$top_receiver))
)

lgd_celltype <- Legend(
  labels = present_celltypes,
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = celltype_cols[present_celltypes]),
  title = "Top senders\nand receivers",
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
)


#5. heatmap - diseases (rows) clustered by their factor loading profile,
# factors (columns) clustered by which diseases activate them similarly

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(min(disease_factor_mat), median(disease_factor_mat), max(disease_factor_mat)),
  c("white", "orange", "firebrick")
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  disease_factor_mat,
  name = "Loading",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = col_ha,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", disease_factor_mat[i, j]),
                     x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  },
  border = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Factor\nloading")
)


#6. save - ONE combined celltype legend attached, not duplicated

dir.create("output/Fusion", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf("output/Fusion/disease_factor_similarity.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_celltype),
     heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
dev.off()
```
